Description: "将新生成的极客科技电路板纯背景图应用为设置中心的 Container 背景，以大幅提升产品的高级感与科幻终端质感。"
Instruction: "在 `build_settings_view` 返回的顶级 `ft.Container` 中，添加 `image_src` 和 `image_fit` 属性，将其路径设为新生成的 `assets/tech_bg.png`，以实现与预览图一致的极客电路纹理背景。"
ReplacementContent:
"        bg_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "assets", "tech_bg.png")
        return ft.Container(
            content=ft.Column(
                [
                    ft.Text("设置中心", size=24, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD),
                    ft.Divider(color="#2a2e39", height=1),
                    ft.Text("MT5 终端路径配置", size=14, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color=ft.Colors.BLUE_200),
                    ft.Row(
                        [
                            self.mt5_path_input,
                            ft.Container(
                                content=self.mt5_browse_button,
                                padding=ft.padding.only(top=6),
                            ),
                        ],
                        spacing=14,
                        vertical_alignment=ft.CrossAxisAlignment.END,
                    ),
                    ft.Divider(color="#2a2e39", height=1),
                    ft.Text("量化策略选择 (点击方块直接切换)", size=14, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color=ft.Colors.BLUE_200),
                    self.strategy_cards_container,
                    ft.Divider(color="#2a2e39", height=1),
                    ft.Text("策略预设参数加载", size=14, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color=ft.Colors.BLUE_200),
                    strategy_preset_row,
                    ft.Container(
                        content=self.save_settings_button,
                        alignment=ft.Alignment(0, 0),
                        padding=ft.padding.only(top=16, bottom=4),
                    ),
                    ft.Container(
                        content=self.save_feedback_box,
                        alignment=ft.Alignment(0, 0),
                    ),
                ],
                spacing=18,
            ),
            padding=40,
            image_src=bg_path,
            image_fit=ft.ImageFit.COVER,
        )"
